ADC Driver (Adc)

Provides initialization and conversion services for analog-to-digital converters.
function Adc_Init [SWS_Adc_00365]
void Adc_Init(const Adc_ConfigType* ConfigPtr);
Initializes the ADC hardware units and driver.
function Adc_SetupResultBuffer [SWS_Adc_91000]
Std_ReturnType Adc_Setup Result Buffer(Adc_GroupType Group, Adc_Value GroupType* Data BufferPtr);

Initializes ADC driver with the group specific result buffer start address where the conversion results will be stored. The applicatio n has to ensure that the application buffer, where Data Buffer Ptr points to, can hold all the conversion results of the specified group. The initialization with Adc_ Setup Result Buffer is required after reset, before a group conversion can be started.
function Adc_DeInit [SWS_Adc_00366]
void Adc_De Init(void);
Returns all ADC HW Units to a state comparable to their power on reset state.
function Adc_StartGroupConversion [SWS_Adc_00367]
void Adc_Start Group Conversion(Adc_GroupType Group);
Starts the conversion of all channels of the requested ADC Channel group.
function Adc_StopGroupConversion [SWS_Adc_00368]
void Adc_Stop Group Conversion(Adc_GroupType Group);
Stops the conversion of the requested ADC Channel group.
function Adc_ReadGroup [SWS_Adc_00369]
Std_ReturnType Adc_Read Group(Adc_GroupType Group, Adc_Value GroupType* Data BufferPtr);

Reads the group conversion result of the last completed conversion round of the requested group and stores the channe l values starting at the Data Buffer Ptr address. The group channel values are stored in ascending channel number order ( in contrast to the storage layout of the result buffer if streaming access is configured).
function Adc_EnableHardwareTrigger [SWS_Adc_91001]
void Adc_Enable Hardware Trigger(Adc_GroupType Group);
Enables the hardware trigger for the requested ADC Channel group.
function Adc_DisableHardwareTrigger [SWS_Adc_91002]
void Adc_Disable Hardware Trigger(Adc_GroupType Group);
Disables the hardware trigger for the requested ADC Channel group.
function Adc_EnableGroupNotification [SWS_Adc_91003]

Enables the notification mechanism for the requested ADC Channel group.
function Adc_DisableGroupNotification [SWS_Adc_91004]
void Adc_Disable Group Notification(Adc_GroupType Group);
Disables the notification mechanism for the requested ADC Channel group.
function Adc_GetGroupStatus [SWS_Adc_00374]
Adc_StatusType Adc_Get Group Status(Adc_GroupType Group);
Returns the conversion status of the requested ADC Channel group.
function Adc_GetStreamLastPointer [SWS_Adc_00375]
Adc_Stream Num SampleType Adc_Get Stream Last Pointer(Adc_GroupType Group, Adc_Value GroupType* * Ptr To SamplePtr);

Returns the number of valid samples per channel, stored in the result buffer. Reads a pointer, pointing to a position in the group result buffer. With the pointer position, the results of all group channels of the last completed conversion round can be acc essed. With the pointer and the return value, all valid group conversion results can be accessed (the user has to take the layout of the result buffer into account).

This API is cyclically called and supervises the power state transitions, checking for the readiness of the module and issuing the callbacks Io Hw Ab_ Adc_ Notify Ready For Power State (see Adc Power State Ready Cb k Ref configuration parameter).

type Adc_ConfigType [SWS_Adc_00505]
Data structure containing the set of configuration parameters required for initializing the ADC Driver and ADC HW Unit(s).
type Adc_ChannelType [SWS_Adc_00506]
Numeric ID of an ADC channel.
type Adc_GroupType [SWS_Adc_00507]
Numeric ID of an ADC channel group.
type Adc_ValueGroupType [SWS_Adc_00508]
Type for reading the converted values of a channel group (raw, without further scaling, alignment according precompile switch ADC_ RESULT_ ALIGNMENT).
type Adc_PrescaleType [SWS_Adc_00509]
Type of clock prescaler factor. (This is not an API type).
type Adc_ConversionTimeType [SWS_Adc_00510]
Type of conversion time, i.e. the time during which the sampled analogue value is converted into digital representation. (This is not an API type).
type Adc_SamplingTimeType [SWS_Adc_00511]
Type of sampling time, i.e. the time during which the value is sampled, (in clock - cycles). (This is not an API type).
type Adc_ResolutionType [SWS_Adc_00512]
Type of channel resolution in number of bits. (This is not an API type).
type Adc_StatusType [SWS_Adc_00513]
Current status of the conversion of the requested ADC Channel group.
type Adc_TriggerSourceType [SWS_Adc_00514]
Type for configuring the trigger source for an ADC Channel group.
type Adc_GroupConvModeType [SWS_Adc_00515]
Type for configuring the conversion mode of an ADC Channel group. AUTOSAR CP R20 - of Document ID : AUTOSAR_SWS_ADCDriver
type Adc_GroupPriorityType [SWS_Adc_00516]
Priority level of the channel. Lowest priority is 0.
type Adc_GroupDefType [SWS_Adc_00517]
Type for assignment of channels to a channel group (this is not an API type).
type Adc_StreamNumSampleType [SWS_Adc_00518]
Type for configuring the number of group conversions in streaming access mode (in single access mode, parameter is 1). Available Adc.h AUTOSAR CP R20 - of Document ID : AUTOSAR_SWS_ADCDriver via
type Adc_StreamBufferModeType [SWS_Adc_00519]
Type for configuring the streaming access mode buffer type.
type Adc_GroupAccessModeType [SWS_Adc_00528]
Type for configuring the access mode to group conversion results.
type Adc_HwTriggerSignalType [SWS_Adc_00520]
Type for configuring on which edge of the hardware trigger signal the driver should react, i.e. start the conversion (only if supported by the ADC hardware).
type Adc_HwTriggerTimerType [SWS_Adc_00521]
Type for the reload value of the ADC module embedded timer (only if supported by the ADC hardware).
type Adc_PriorityImplementationType [SWS_Adc_00522]
Type for configuring the prioritization mechanism.
type Adc_GroupReplacementType [SWS_Adc_00523]
Replacement mechanism, which is used on ADC group level, if a group conversion is interrupted by a group which has a higher priority.
type Adc_Channel [SWS_Adc_00524]
In case of active limit checking: defines which conversion values are taken into account related to the boardes defineed with Adc Channel Low Limit and Adc Channel High Limit.
type Adc_ResultAlignmentType [SWS_Adc_00525]
Type for alignment of ADC raw results in ADC result buffer (left/ right alignment).
type Adc_PowerStateType [SWS_Adc_00526]
Power state currently active or set as target power state.
type Adc_PowerStateRequestResultType [SWS_Adc_00527]
Type Adc_PowerStateRequestResultType.
